Tool calls in live session stream should render collapsed by default, not expanded
────────────────────────────────────────
ULID:      01KK3BSWT9NQHKEZ19P97VT3SV
Type:      task
Status:    needs_work
Priority:  2
Automation: eligible

─── Description ───
  When viewing a live agent session, new tool call entries often appear expanded (showing full input/output) as they stream in. They should always render collapsed by default and only expand when the user explicitly clicks to expand. The issue likely occurs because the ToolCallView component's expanded state defaults to true or gets set to true during the streaming/refresh cycle when new events arrive. Fix: (1) ensure ToolCallView initializes with expanded=false, (2) preserve user-toggled expand state across periodic structured refreshes (don't reset expanded state when the event list is re-rendered from events.jsonl refresh), (3) new tool call entries appearing during live streaming should always start collapsed.
Spec ref:  @ui-session-stream
Tags:      bug, web-ui
Created:   2026-03-07T05:19:57.769Z
Started:   2026-03-07T09:20:35.740Z

─── Spec Context ───
Session Stream View
Type: feature
Implementation: in_progress
Description:
  View for watching agent work — both historical and live. Renders structured
  session events (messages, tool calls, thinking blocks) from events.jsonl.
  Live sessions show streaming text with periodic structured refresh.
Acceptance Criteria:
  [ac-1]
    Given: A completed session with events.jsonl

    When: The user navigates to /sessions/:id

    Then: The session events render as structured blocks: agent messages (markdown),
tool calls (collapsible with icon, input/output, timing), and thinking blocks
(collapsed by default, expandable)

  [ac-2]
    Given: An active session with streaming output

    When: The user views the session

    Then: Live text streams in real-time via agent_text_chunk WebSocket events,
with periodic structured refresh from events.jsonl

  [ac-3]
    Given: The session stream view

    When: New content arrives while auto-scrolling

    Then: The view auto-scrolls to follow new content, pauses when user scrolls up
(>100px from bottom), and resumes when scrolled back. A "jump to bottom"
button appears when paused.

  [ac-4]
    Given: The session stream view

    When: A session context panel is shown on the left

    Then: It displays session metadata, spec context with AC checklist,
files changed during session, and budget info

  [ac-5]
    Given: A collapsed tool call row in the session stream
    When: The tool call name or parameters are long, or the viewport is narrow
    Then: The row stays a single line height: the expand chevron, timestamp, tool icon, tool name, parameter summary, and timing/status indicators are always visible. Content is truncated with ellipsis rather than wrapping to multiple lines.

─── Notes ───

- Completed tool calls render collapsed

- Click toggle works (expand/collapse)
- User-expanded state persists across periodic refresh cycles

fix(web-ui): render tool calls collapsed by default and add ac-5 init test

ToolCallView initialized expanded state as $state(block.status === 'running'),
causing running tool calls to auto-expand during live streaming. Changed to
$state(false) so all tool calls start collapsed regardless of status. Added
test verifying the collapsed-by-default initialization.

Task: @01KK3BSWT9NQHKEZ19P97VT3SV

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.6 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
